balducci1983.locator: Table I p5617, error discussion p5618, Tables IV-V p5620, Appendix p5621 and reference15 p5622
balducci1983.experiment: Knudsen-effusion mass spectrometry; molybdenum cell with Eu2O3/V2O5/V mixture, 70 eV electron ionization, optical pyrometry; fragmentation and multiple-ionization corrections, estimated molecular ionization cross sections and silver pressure calibration.
balducci1983.EuO_reference: Reference15: mean of Murad/Hildenbrand and Balducci/Gigli/Guido values listed under reference14; original auxiliary papers not inspected.
balducci1983.covariance_note: Different reaction measurements are not independent inferred atomization energies: both routes use the same VO and EuO anchor. The paper does not provide a covariance matrix. No revised combined uncertainty is claimed.

thermal_model.references: V and VO functions from JANAF1975; Eu and EuO from authors previous work; VO2 frequencies and angle from matrix-isolation work by Serebrennikov/Maltsev, estimated bond length.
thermal_model.limitation: Constant electronic ground weight; 538 cm^-1 bend differs markedly from the later cryo-SEVI ground-state value291(2) cm^-1. Historical thermal model is not a complete1500-4000K candidate.

balducci1983.table_IV_pressure_caution: Pressure measurements are quoted in atm, but the table does not explicitly specify standard pressure. Only enthalpy increments are compared across sources; its entropy is reconstructed in the printed convention without assigning an atm-to-bar correction.

gunina2012_supporting_information.inspection: Tables S1-S3 (S2-S5), B3LYP structures (S6-S7) and ROHF structure-catalogue headings (S8-S45); no main text supplied.
gunina2012_supporting_information.contents: Partial pressures and third-law reaction heats for V2O3-W and V2O3-SiO2-Mo systems; VMoO4/VWO3/VWO4 geometries, electronic energies and selected ZPE.
gunina2012_supporting_information.reaction_numbering_caution: Cover and table column labels use7-11, whereas captions use10-14. Do not silently map these to main-text reactions without that article.
